texts: The Power Rangers Dino Fury series began its development in 2019. However, it didn't premiere until 2021. The production was impacted due to the COVID-19 pandemic, which caused delays in filming. The series is the 39th installment in the Power Rangers franchise, and it marks the 28th season of the television series. The production company, Saban Brands, announced the series in 2019 during Power Morphicon, an annual Power Rangers convention held in California. The show was created by Chip Lynn and Heather Schoner.

"Power Rangers Dino Fury" began its development process in the period following the conclusion of "Power Rangers Beast Morphers." While exact dates for the start of development are not widely publicized, it is known that Hasbro and Saban Brands (now part of Hasbro) typically begin planning and developing new seasons of Power Rangers several months to a year in advance.

Given that "Power Rangers Dino Fury" premiered on February 14, 2021, it's reasonable to estimate that the initial development and planning stages likely started around late 2019 or early 2020. This timeline would allow for scriptwriting, casting, costume design, special effects planning, and other pre-production activities to be completed in time for filming and post-production.

"Power Rangers Dino Fury," which is part of the long-running "Power Rangers" franchise, officially began development under the working title "Power Rangers Beast Morphers." Development started in earnest around late 2018 or early 2019, with pre-production activities like casting, scriptwriting, and character development happening beforehand. "Power Rangers Dino Fury" was officially announced on September 26, 2019, by Hasbro, which had acquired the Power Rangers franchise from Saban Brands.

The series premiered on March 21, 2021, on Nickelodeon, continuing the tradition of mixing live-action with CGI effects to bring the adventures of the Rangers to life. "Power Rangers Dino Fury" features a team of five high school students who gain the ability to transform into the Power Rangers, equipped with Dino Fury Powers and the Dino Charge Megazord.

The show introduces a new storyline set in the fictional city of Mondo City, where the Rangers battle the alien villain, the Void Knight, and his army of aliens known as the Void Zombies. The series incorporates elements from the "Dino Charge" and "Dino Super Charge" seasons, continuing the dinosaur theme that was introduced in those series.
